youtube.title: How to Reply to Cleaning Quote Requests at Night With AI (You Still Hit Send)
youtube.description:
How to reply to cleaning quote requests at night: AI drafts it, you send it.
For cleaning business owners and home service business owners.
Jobber, "Blue Collar Strong: The 2026 Home Service Trends Report": a survey of 1,050 home service business owners across the United States, conducted through Conjointly in December 2025 (margin of error plus or minus 3 points at 90% confidence). Cleaning businesses were the fastest responders: 26% said they reply to leads within an hour.

Steps (the prompt is an example):
1. Paste the customer's message into an AI chat app.
2. Add this prompt and your own rates: "Write a short, friendly reply to this cleaning quote request. Use my rates below. Ask one question if anything's missing."
3. Read the draft, fix anything wrong, and send it yourself.

Send this to whoever answers your quote requests.
